params.body:
On Curate's front page, the trend cards had a green-grey (#EBF0EC) that gentells.com does not use. On the site, posts and trends are both cards in stone (`--color-stone`, #EFEFEC). Curate's post cards already had that colour.

## Change

- `.gt-card` now uses #EFEFEC, so trends and posts have the same card colour.
- The lead stays mint and the reports stay black, as on the site (`--color-mint-light` for the featured post, `--color-night` for the report band).

## Checked

- `npm run build` is clean. Only the colour changes.
params.title: Curate: trend cards in the site's stone, like the posts
